# World Map Interchange (WMI)

> An experimental 0.1.0 draft format, MIT licensed, for exchanging georeferenced world maps (elevation, climate,
> classes, masks) between worldbuilding and terrain tools. A package is a ZIP or folder with manifest.json and 16-bit
> greyscale PNGs that have explicit linear decode ranges, units, quantities, grids and time statistics. It is a
> proposal for joint development, not an endorsed standard.

Start with AGENTS.md (rules and key facts), then docs/integration-guide.md (step-by-step procedure for adding
import/export to existing software).

## Core

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Cradoux/world-map-interchange/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules and key facts for coding agents
- [Integration guide](https://github.com/Cradoux/world-map-interchange/blob/main/docs/integration-guide.md): adding WMI to existing software, with tests and definition of done
- [Specification 0.1.0](https://github.com/Cradoux/world-map-interchange/blob/main/spec/0.1.0/specification.md): normative rules
- [Quantity registry](https://github.com/Cradoux/world-map-interchange/blob/main/spec/0.1.0/quantity-registry.md): quantities, units, qualifiers
- [Manifest JSON Schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Cradoux/world-map-interchange/main/schemas/0.1.0/manifest.schema.json)
- [Registry JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Cradoux/world-map-interchange/main/registry/0.1.0/quantities.json)
